meta.siteTitle: Dayline: every day, on one line
meta.siteDescription: A day record for families of autistic children, kept on your phone. Guides, Help now, reminders and a brief for whoever is next. No account, works offline, in Bangla and English.

landing.title: Dayline: every day, on one line
landing.description: Doses, sleep and hard moments on one line, on your phone. A brief for the next caregiver, a two-page PDF for each doctor, and guides that help from day one. No account, works offline.

hero.title: Every day, on one line.
hero.body: Dayline keeps doses, sleep and hard moments on one line, on your phone. Show the next caregiver a simple brief, and send each doctor a two-page PDF on WhatsApp. And it helps from day one, even if you never log a thing.
reassure: Your data stays on your phone
hero.phoneAlt: Dayline on a phone: Today for a boy called Rafi, with something to watch for, the next dose with a Mark given button, and the day so far on one line.

useful.title: Useful from day one
useful.body: Most trackers need weeks of logging before they help. Dayline is useful the first time you open it, and keeps being useful when life gets busy and nobody logs.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Five everyday workflows. None of them asks you to fill in a form.

workflows.label: The daily loop
steps: Tap once when something happens, or just mark the dose
The day line fills itself in, colour by colour
Show the next caregiver a brief, or send it as a PDF

workflows.label: A hard moment
steps: Try what works for your child, from the playbook
Tap “It's over”: the moment is saved with what helped

workflows.label: A change
steps: Note a new medicine, dose or routine
Two weeks later, see before and after, with overlaps flagged
Keep it, or add it to the next visit

workflows.label: A doctor visit
steps: Prep in 60 seconds, from memory if needed
One short report for each doctor
Every prescriber's changes on one page

workflows.label: Coming back after weeks
steps: Three yes/no questions about what changed
Back to today, as if you never left

privacy.description: No accounts. No server. Your child's data stays on your phone.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: No accounts. No server. Your child's data stays on your phone.

sections.title: What Dayline collects
sections.body: Nothing. There is no sign-up, no account, no analytics and no advertising. The site and app only ever talk to this website, to load the pages and guides.

sections.title: Where your child's record lives
sections.body: Everything you add in the app (your child's profile, medicines, the day line) is stored in your browser's storage on this phone. It is not copied to any server, because Dayline doesn't have one.

sections.title: How anything leaves your phone
sections.body: Only when you choose: you show the brief on your screen, send a PDF (for example on WhatsApp), print, or save a backup file. Each of these is made on your phone.

sections.title: Backups matter
sections.body: Because the record lives only on this phone, clearing the browser's data or losing the phone loses it. Dayline reminds you once a month to save a backup file somewhere safe.

sections.title: Deleting
sections.body: You can export everything or delete everything at any time from the app's settings. Uninstalling or clearing site data also deletes it.

sections.title: Not medical advice
sections.body: Dayline is a record and a reminder, not a diagnostic tool or a medical device. It never suggests doses or changes to treatment; ask the prescriber.
